args.name: shared-package
args.purpose: @repo/shared validators consumed by both apps; cross-cut domain owned by the monorepo root, not by any single app.

args.name: monorepo-architecture
args.purpose: pnpm workspace topology, package boundaries, and dependency graph

args.name: e2e-flows
args.purpose: Cross-app flows that traverse web and api together (per Invariant 2)

args.name: E2E Create Item End To End
args.goal: Submit an item via apps/web/_testatlas/flows/FLOW-web-routing-submit-item-form.md, watch it POST to apps/api/_testatlas/flows/FLOW-items-api-create-item.md, and confirm validateItem from @repo/shared accepts the same shape on both ends.

args.name: Package Version Sync Check
args.goal: Verify @repo/shared workspace:* protocol resolves to a single version across apps/web and apps/api after pnpm install

args.description: pnpm list output showing @repo/shared resolved twice with different file: refs after a partial workspace install

args.title: Shared package version drift risk across apps
args.summary: If a developer pins @repo/shared in one app's package.json instead of using workspace:*, the apps can ship divergent validator behavior. apps/web/_testatlas and apps/api/_testatlas would each pass their own checks while the e2e flow silently breaks.
